name: supercarto-bench
description: Benchmark fixtures and raw runs for comparing map-data representations for LLM agents (compiled topological graph vs raw GeoJSON vs no map) on accuracy and context-token cost. Fixtures: unmemorizable synthetic micro-areas plus eight Overpass-derived city extracts. See docs/datasheet.md for the full datasheet and docs/benchmark-sop.txt for the methodology checklist it was worked from.

distribution.name: synthetic-fixtures-apache-2.0
distribution.description: Original synthetic fixtures (fake coordinates, fake names). Apache-2.0.

distribution.name: osm-derived-fixtures-odbl
distribution.description: Overpass-derived city extracts. ODbL 1.0, © OpenStreetMap contributors. See fixtures/bench/ATTRIBUTION.md.

distribution.name: raw-run-archives
distribution.description: Raw model-call archives (prompts, answers, token counts) behind every published number. Re-score with scripts/report-free-ladder.ts.

recordSet.name: benchmark-tasks
recordSet.description: One row per (task, arm, seed): task id, representation shown, model answer, programmatic verdict. See bench-results/*.report.json.

field.name: correct
field.description: True, false, or null when unscoreable.
